TRAIN UNITS
Land units train as a full 100-man cohort. Once ready, a cohort can still march after losing men. Reinforce refills it over time only in its original home city — garrison it there and use Reinforce (Army tab). Ships are built one at a time.
Spearmen
requires barracks
Train 100

requires stable
Train 100

requires shipyard
